topic: The Phantom Frequency: Curiosities of Ghost Radio, Unexplained Acoustics & Sonic Relics

changelog.summary: Launched an interactive daily-updating archive of mysterious radio broadcasts, deep-ocean anomalies, and acoustic ghosts with an interactive Web Audio signal synthesizer.
Added audio output gain slider, demodulation mode switcher (AM/USB/LSB), copy telemetry coordinates with toast, phonetic cipher decoder reference tool, and CRT scanlines visual effects.
Added an ionospheric QRN atmospheric static generator to the audio tuner and introduced an interactive historical cipher intercept breakdown module.
Added an interactive S-Meter signal strength gauge to the receiver tuner and introduced an ionospheric propagation telemetry section with solar flux monitoring.
Added interactive shortwave receiver frequency step-tuning with live heterodyne pitch shift, and introduced a shortwave listener (SWL) reception report generator.

Added an interactive real-time shortwave SDR waterfall spectrogram display mode to the receiver visualizer and upgraded the tuner console with tactile indicator LEDs and glowing segment display styling.
Added a DSP bandpass bandwidth filter (6.0k / 2.4k / 0.5k) to the audio tuner and introduced an interactive historical intercept logbook with category filtering.
Added an interactive multi-site transmitter triangulation recon dossier and an RF receiver front-end attenuator (ATT: 0/-10/-20 dB) with live audio gain and S-meter scaling.
Added interactive QRM solar burst interference simulator to audio tuner and added CRT phosphor display color palette selector for oscilloscope visualizer.

Added a global WebSDR receiver node selector to simulate reception across international listening posts, and upgraded the tuner console with military chassis hardware screws, serial nameplate, and CRT shadow styling.
Added an interactive Ionospheric Grayline Twilight Surge Predictor section and upgraded the tuner console visual styling with an illuminated vacuum pilot lamp and CRT glass glare.
Added an interactive 52-Hertz Whale acoustic simulator to the upcoming queue section and implemented synthesized tactile mechanical relay click sounds on all receiver console switches.
